desc: Parse N, M, start, houses, and commands; assign each house a unique id.
Simulate moves to get final (X,Y) and build `h_intervals[y]` / `v_intervals[x]` as inclusive intervals.
Build `by_y[y]` (house x, id) and `by_x[x]` (house y, id) groupings.
Merge intervals per row/column and mark covered houses via bisect on merged starts.
Print final X, Y, and count of covered houses; sample tests passed on both provided samples.
